summary: Phase 5 AI Features (Smart Replies & Translation) testing completed. FIXED route conflict bug - /api/ai prefix was used by both ai_assistant.py and ai_features.py causing translate endpoint to fail. Changed ai_features routes to /api/ai-chat prefix. All 14 backend tests pass. Translation UI fully verified - quick translate + language picker dropdown with 12 languages working. SmartReplies component integrated but requires real incoming message to trigger (WebSocket event).

fixed.issue: Route conflict - both ai_assistant.py and ai_features.py used /api/ai prefix. ai_assistant's translate endpoint (uses query params) was registered first, overriding ai_features.py's translate (uses JSON body). Frontend sent JSON body but backend expected query params.
fixed.fix: Changed ai_features.router prefix from /api/ai to /api/ai-chat. Updated frontend components to use /api/ai-chat/smart-replies and /api/ai-chat/translate

issue.symptom: POST /api/ai/translate returned 422 validation error despite sending correct JSON body
issue.root_cause: Both ai_assistant.py (line 250: uses query params) and ai_features.py (line 106: uses JSON body) defined /translate endpoint. FastAPI registered ai_assistant.py first (line 138) before ai_features.py (line 208), so the query params version won.
issue.fix: Changed ai_features.py router prefix to /api/ai-chat in server.py (line 208). Updated frontend SmartReplies.jsx and TranslateButton.jsx to use new endpoint paths.
